description: Uncertain entries of the world model: `entry` names the fact left open ({of, attr, time}; `of` "?" when the question is who). `raised`: the paragraph (and quote) where the story opens it; null while the story never doubts it (`latent`). `possibilities`: every answer the story makes available, each `{value, how?, available, via, from?, quote?, out?, by?}`. `available` is the paragraph from which the answer may be listed; `via` is `direct` (the story names it as a possibility), `indirect` (it follows from what has been told, or a careful reader's thought: `from` a fact or "thought t<id>") or `always` ("something else", on every question from the paragraph it is raised). `quote` is the words that make it available, found in that paragraph (for answers that become available after the facts so far run out). `out`/`by`: the paragraph and fact that rule it out. `answer` is always one of the possibilities, or null where the story never settles it. `also_right`: other possibilities just as true as `answer` (the light as well as the noise; the bets as well as the debts), judged right too and not contradicting it. `answer_inferable_at` (with `answer_from`, a fact or thought, and `answer_strength: likely` when a careful reader would hold it but it does not follow strictly) is the earliest paragraph a reader can reach the answer, null when only the give-away brings it; `answer_given_at`/`answer_given_quote` where the story gives it away. `old`: the old game's question or slot.

possibilities.value: dead, in a pit or mine

reasoning.text: Where is he: dead, in a pit or mine; taken far away; hidden among horses, at a stable; loose on the moor? A famous horse loose on the moor would have been seen. At a stable is the live one.

possibilities.how: hidden among horses at a stable

reasoning.text: Only two stables are in reach: King's Pyland and Mapleton. If the horse is hidden among horses nearby, it is at Mapleton.

questions.answer_given_quote: He tried to bluster out of it, but I described to him so exactly what his actions had been
